tools.name: Sun Path & Shadow
tools.summary: NOAA sun position, sun-path diagram, plan shadow, hourly shadow table

tools.name: Vastu Grid Overlay
tools.summary: upload plan, set north, 16/8 zones, 3x3/9x9 grid, save image

tools.name: Sheet Fit & Scale
tools.summary: largest scale per sheet, shrunk print fixer, ruler to real, SVG scale bar

tools.name: Staircase Designer
tools.summary: Risers, treads, flights and the slab opening for headroom, checked against NBC 2016, with live section and plan.

tools.name: Shading Device Sizer
tools.summary: Overhang (chajja) and fin depths from real sun angles for any city, wall direction, date and hours.

tools.name: Kitchen Work Triangle
tools.summary: Drag the sink, hob and fridge on a plan. Each leg and the total are checked live against the work-triangle rules.

tools.name: Room Acoustics RT60
tools.summary: Reverberation time from room size and finishes, checked against a target, with how much absorption to add.

tools.name: Rainwater Harvesting
tools.summary: Yearly roof yield, tank size for a design storm, days of supply and paved runoff for a recharge pit.

tools.name: Lighting Layout
tools.summary: How many fittings for your lux target, on an even ceiling grid with spacing check, average lux and W/m².

tools.name: Daylight Factor
tools.summary: Average daylight factor (BRE) from room, window, glass and obstruction; IS 2440 targets, NBC window-to-floor rule, window width needed.

tools.name: Accessible Ramp
tools.summary: Runs, landings, total length and straight/switchback footprint of a ramp, checked against ADA 2010, UK Part M or custom limits.

tools.name: Brick & Mortar
tools.summary: Bricks, cement bags and sand for a wall with openings, IS 1077 sizes, wet-to-dry mortar factor, full working.

tools.name: Floor Tile Layout
tools.summary: Tile-by-tile floor layout (straight, offset, diagonal), full/cut count, sliver warning, boxes, skirting, grout.

tools.name: Room Furnisher
tools.summary: Automatic furniture layout for bedroom, living, dining, study with clearance zones, door swing and window rules; cycles valid layouts.

tools.name: Sliding Door & Window
tools.summary: Shutter and glass sizes with interlock, clear opening, glass weight vs rollers, pocket walls, cutting list; animated opening.

tools.name: Plot Envelope & FAR
tools.summary: Setbacks, ground coverage, FAR and height applied together; governing rule, unused FAR, 3D envelope, floor schedule.

tools.name: Carpet Area (RERA)
tools.summary: RERA carpet, built-up and super built-up from room sizes, loading factor, real price per carpet sq ft, area statement.

tools.name: Cut & Fill
tools.summary: Four corner levels, building pad, cut/fill volumes, balanced level with shrinkage, truckloads with swell, contours and section.

tools.name: Rooftop Solar Layout
tools.summary: Panel rows with shade-free gaps for the winter sun, parapet and stair-room shadows kept clear, with kWp and yearly units.

tools.name: Wall U-Value
tools.summary: Layer-by-layer U-value with the temperature through the wall and the insulation needed for the ECBC 2017 limit in your climate.

tools.name: Parking Layout
tools.summary: Draws every bay and aisle for 90°, 60°, 45°, 30° or parallel parking, counts the cars that really fit and checks the ECS count.

tools.name: Plaster & Paint Quantity
tools.summary: Plaster area with IS 1200 opening deductions and reveals, cement, sand, primer, putty and paint, walls drawn flat.

tools.name: Retaining Wall Check
tools.summary: Rankine thrust, overturning and sliding factors, base pressure and smallest passing base for a gravity wall.

tools.name: Bathroom Planner
tools.summary: WC, basin, shower and door placed on a plan, checked for NBC size, IPC/IBC clearances, shower size and door swing.

tools.name: Camera Lens & Framing
tools.summary: Field of view in plan and section, wall framing check and the longest lens that fits.

tools.name: Roof Pitch & Rafter
tools.summary: Ridge rise, rafter length, true sloping area and sheet count from the roof angle.

tools.name: Render Size for Print
tools.summary: Pixels needed for a sheet from the viewing distance (1 arcmin acuity), against 300 ppi, with your render checked.

tools.name: Natural Ventilation
tools.summary: Wind (Cd·A·V) and stack airflow through two openings, air changes per hour and the IMC ventilation rate check.

tools.name: Arch & Curve Setting-out
tools.summary: Circular-segment radius, centre, arc length and setting-out ordinates from span and rise, with voussoirs drawn.

tools.name: Driveway Turning
tools.summary: Single-track swept path of a car round a 90° corner with wall clearance and the narrowest lane that works.

tools.name: Sightline & Seating Rake
tools.summary: Riser of every row from the C-value so each seat sees over the heads in front, with a live section.

tools.name: Drain Gradient & Invert Levels
tools.summary: Fall, invert levels and cover at each manhole, with Manning flow speed and a self-cleansing check.

tools.name: Water Demand & Tank Sizing
tools.summary: Daily water demand from NBC litres per head, sump, overhead tank and pump size for any building.

tools.name: Spiral Staircase Geometry
tools.summary: Risers, the tread depth at the walkline where you really walk, clear width and the floor opening for headroom, on a live plan and unrolled section.

tools.name: Gutter & Downpipe Sizer
tools.summary: Peak roof flow from rainfall and area, gutter capacity by Manning, downpipe inlet capacity and how many downpipes the roof needs.

tools.name: AC Cooling Load
tools.summary: Item-by-item cooling load for a room in watts and tons of refrigeration, the next standard AC size and the 1 TR per 100 sq ft rule checked.

tools.name: Car Ramp Scrape Check
tools.summary: Car ramp scrape check with transition length for the car's clearance and angles.

tools.name: Baluster & Slat Spacing
tools.summary: Equal-gap baluster and slat layout with posts, cut list and sphere test.

tools.name: Perspective Setup
tools.summary: Two-point perspective set-up: vanishing points in mm, view angle and sheet layout.

tools.name: Shelf Sag Check
tools.summary: Sag of a loaded shelf now and over time for MDF, particleboard, plywood or solid wood, the longest span that passes and the thickness you need.

tools.name: Curtain Fabric Calculator
tools.summary: Widths, cut drop matched to the pattern repeat and the metres of fabric and lining to order, with returns, overlaps, hems and a cutting plan.

tools.name: Screen Size for a Room
tools.summary: Screen size a room really needs from the farthest viewer and the content (4/6/8 rule), mounting height, ceiling and viewing-angle checks and the projector throw.

tools.name: Plot Area from Sides
tools.summary: True area of a four-sided plot from its sides and one diagonal by two triangles, drawn to scale, in m², sq ft, gaj, guntha, cent and acre.

tools.name: Sign Letter Height
tools.summary: Minimum letter height for a sign from the viewing distance and mounting height (ADA 703.5.5), against the 1 in per 10 ft rule, with a live elevation.

tools.name: Model Scale & Board
tools.summary: Every wall, slab and floor height in model millimetres for any scale, the board or stack of two that matches best, the base size and sheets to buy.

tools.name: Terrace Screed Falls
tools.summary: Hip-and-valley screed falls to the outlets, the thickest point, the real valley fall, screed volume and dead load, with outlet layouts compared.

tools.name: Pool Volume & Turnover
tools.summary: True water volume of a pool with a sloping floor, the pump flow from the turnover time, filter area and diameter and the pipe bore, on a live long section.

tools.name: Cladding Panel Layout
tools.summary: Equal cladding panels from the facade size, max panel, joint and folded return, the blanks per stock sheet, sheets to order and yield, with row options.

tools.name: Slope & Contour
tools.summary: Slope in %, degrees and 1 in n from the contour gap on a survey, the true length along the ground and the contour gap for any target slope.

tools.name: Brick Jali Open Area
tools.summary: Open area, bearing and bricks per m² of a honeycomb brick jali for any gap, with the whole panel drawn brick by brick.

tools.name: Pergola Slat Shade
tools.summary: Shade on the floor under pergola slats at any hour from the real sun, slat width, depth, gap and direction, with hours of full shade and a day chart.

tools.name: Exhaust Fan & Door Gap
tools.summary: Exhaust airflow for kitchens, bathrooms and WCs from ASHRAE 62.2 or UK Part F, the fan size, air changes and the gap under the door the air needs.

tools.name: Kitchen Cabinet Modules
tools.summary: The mix of standard cabinet widths that fills a kitchen wall around the sink, hob and appliances with the smallest fillers, as a live elevation and plan.

tools.name: Axonometric Setup
tools.summary: Axis angles and x, y, z scales for isometric, dimetric, trimetric, plan oblique and cavalier views from the plan turn and eye angle, with your building drawn live.

tools.name: Hip Roof Geometry
tools.summary: True hip rafter length, backing angle, every jack rafter and the roof area of an equal-pitch hip roof, on a live plan with a cut list.

tools.name: Bi-fold Door Planner
tools.summary: Panel width, folded stack, projection and the real clear opening of a bi-fold door, with a plan you can fold open and a lead door check.

tools.name: Brick Bond Planner
tools.summary: Every course of English, Flemish, stretcher or header bond set out with queen closers and bats, straight joints flagged in red and the bricks counted.
